online.intro: LernLab goes online in only these three cases:
online.updates: Checking for updates on GitHub, while “Update automatically” is on.
online.gallery: Loading a deck from the deck gallery, when you ask for it.
online.aiAssistant: Your AI assistant, if you connect one and turn it on below: LernLab itself stays offline, but what the assistant reads is sent to its AI company.
online.outro: Nothing else leaves your computer: no account, no tracking. The one exception is pictures and sounds from the internet, and only if you turn that on below.

assistant.enable: Let an AI assistant use LernLab
assistant.enableHint: Off until you turn it on. Works with AI apps that support MCP (Model Context Protocol), such as Claude Desktop.
assistant.privacy: LernLab itself never goes online for this. While this is on, the assistant you connect can read your decks, cards, answers and study history, and whatever it reads is sent to that assistant's AI company under its privacy terms. It cannot change or delete anything itself: what it proposes waits for you under AI requests, and nothing changes until you accept it. Turn this off at any time and it can read nothing.
assistant.connect: To connect, add this to your assistant's MCP settings (in Claude Desktop: Settings → Developer → Edit Config), then restart the assistant:
assistant.guide: How to connect an assistant (setup guide)

about.licence: LernLab is free and open source under the {{licence}} licence.

remoteMedia.label: Allow pictures and sounds from the internet
remoteMedia.hint: Off by default. Some shared decks link pictures, videos or sounds from websites instead of including them. While this is off, those cards show a note instead, and everything stored in your decks still works.
remoteMedia.warnTitle: Load pictures and sounds from the internet?
remoteMedia.warnBody: Cards that link media from a website will contact that website each time you study them. That website can see your IP address and when you study. The links come from the people who made the deck, not from LernLab, so LernLab can't check what they show and isn't responsible for that content. You turn this on at your own risk, and you can turn it off at any time.

settings.confidenceHint: After an answer, one optional tap from 1 to 5. It never changes when a card comes back; Progress shows how well it matches what you really recall.
